translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.79:1: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly
verses.79:2: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently
verses.79:4: and those taking the lead vigorously
verses.79:6: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass
verses.79:8: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺
verses.79:10: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state
verses.79:11: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”
verses.79:12: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”
verses.79:13: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast
verses.79:14: and at once they will be above ground
verses.79:15: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.79:16: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
verses.79:17: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺
verses.79:18: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself
verses.79:19: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”
verses.79:20: Then Moses showed him the great sign
verses.79:22: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺
verses.79:23: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out
verses.79:24: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”
verses.79:25: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next
verses.79:26: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺
verses.79:27: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
verses.79:28: raising it high and forming it flawlessly
verses.79:29: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight
verses.79:30: As for the earth, He spread it out as well
verses.79:31: bringing forth its water and pastures
verses.79:32: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—
verses.79:33: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals
verses.79:34: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—
verses.79:35: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving
verses.79:36: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
verses.79:37: then as for those who transgressed
verses.79:38: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
verses.79:39: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home
verses.79:40: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires
verses.79:42: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”
verses.79:43: But it is not for you to tell its time
verses.79:44: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺
verses.79:45: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it
verses.79:46: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning
